description: NaSmGeO₄ is Spinel-derived structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent SmO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent GeO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent SmO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent GeO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 61-67°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.44-2.56 Å. Sm is bonded to six O atoms to form SmO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent SmO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent GeO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one GeO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 50-67°. There are a spread of Sm-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.43 Å. Ge is bonded to four O atoms to form GeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent SmO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one SmO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 47-62°. There are a spread of Ge-O bond distances ranging from 1.75-1.81 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Sm, and one Ge atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, two equivalent Sm, and one Ge atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Sm, and one Ge atom.
